content.comment_body: When loading a custom web page, the system is redirected back to the session start (login) page. What could be causing this issue? Thanks, [user_name]

Could you provide more details? Please specify the exact [product_name] and include its full [article_no]. Which [product_name] [version_no] are you using? If possible, upload your web editor project and program files as a ZIP for review.

I'm encountering a similar issue. My [product_name] [version_no] with a custom web server works correctly when accessed locally, but when I connect via VPN using remote hardware, the page loads and then quickly returns to the login screen. The standard web server and display pages load fine. I've managed to get the custom web server to work remotely only once, and I suspect it was by chance. Locally, it loads reliably every time. It seems the page renders, but when it attempts to fetch live data, it redirects back to login. I'm appending :8080 to the IP address per the manual, but this hasn't resolved the issue, and I've tried omitting it as well. Any advice would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing an issue where accessing custom web pages on [product_name] devices through VPN results in repeated redirects to the login page, whereas local access works normally. This points to potential problems with session handling or authentication when using remote connections. The issue reduces usability for users who need reliable remote monitoring or control.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the custom web server pages on [product_name] devices to be consistently accessible and functional from remote VPN connections, matching the reliability of local access and standard web pages.
